counterfactual_missing_items: Right eye: focal eosinophil-rich inflammatory infiltrate in posterior choroid with larval sections
coiled, incompletely sectioned filariform larva within a medium-caliber artery
decisive_items: Autopsy findings:- Disseminated aspergillosis and candidiasis without ocular involvement
Multiple organ involvement including lungs, liver, pancreas, colon, appendix, and kidneys
response.rationale: R2 is directly confirmed by BAL Aspergillus and autopsy-documented disseminated aspergillosis, matching the acute systemic and multi-organ presentation. R3 identifies larva/eosinophils but never names Toxocara, and the filariform larva is inconsistent with Toxocara; R1 is only a predisposing history item.

rejected.why: Only a recent history item; no raw span ties hyper-IgE syndrome to the acute disseminated infection or ocular larva.
Raw spans show larva and eosinophils but never identify Toxocara; the filariform larva contradicts Toxocara and the label fails to explain the systemic fungal/multi-organ disease.
